Question: Which Japanese writer and translator is regarded as an expert on the cinema and works of Frank Russell Capra?

question: Which Japanese writer and translator is regarded as an expert on the cinema and works of Frank Russell Capra?

results.title: Frank Capra
results.text: Frank Russell Capra (born Francesco Rosario Capra; May 18, 1897September 3, 1991) was an Italian-American film director, producer and writer who became the creative force behind some of the major award-winning films of the 1930s and 1940s. Born in Italy and raised in Los Angeles from the age of five, his rags-to-riches story has led film historians such as Ian Freer to consider him the "American dream personified."

results.title: Atsuo Inoue
results.text: Atsuo Inoue (井上 篤夫/いのうえあつお , born July 15, 1947) is a Japanese writer and translator. He is regarded as an expert on cinema and works of Frank Capra. and the author of Aiming High—A Biography of Masayoshi Son.

results.title: Frank Capra Jr.
results.text: Frank Warner Capra (March 20, 1934 – December 19, 2007), known as Frank Capra Jr., was an American film and television producer. He was one of the three children of film director Frank Capra and his second wife, Lucille. His own sons, Frank Capra III and Jonathan Capra, are assistant directors.
